name: openhands

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. OpenHands' SWE-bench score (41.7) was reported with Claude.

SANDBOX_RUNTIME_CONTAINER_IMAGE.description: Docker image for the sandbox runtime. Defaults to ghcr.io/all-hands-ai/runtime.

WORKSPACE_BASE.description: Host directory mounted into the sandbox. Defaults to the calling repo root.

notes: Autonomous SWE platform — runs inside a Docker sandbox with full shell + browser. Highest trust floor in the coding category; defaults to MONITOR so the operator sees every action before tier promotion.
